description: Local MCP server (PM-MCP) that takes over plan-marshall's process logic through a hypermedia-driven workflow: the server owns the plan state machine and answers with state plus pre-fabricated next tool calls. Currently a Quarkus application with a single hello MCP tool, shipped as a container image.
description_reasoning: README.adoc 'What is it?' section and CLAUDE.md project summary

documentation.description: AsciiDoc project documentation: the target-state concept for PM-MCP (architecture, hypermedia workflow, skill model, tool surface, build execution, container backend, security, technology, migration, test strategy) plus discussions of evaluated variants, and the LogMessages catalog for PM_MCP LogRecords.

plan-marshall-mcp.description: The PM-MCP server itself: a Quarkus application exposing the MCP tool surface over Streamable HTTP at /mcp (port 8080), with readiness health on management port 9000 and a shell-free --health-probe entry point used as the container HEALTHCHECK. Packaged as a JVM container image via src/main/docker/Dockerfile.jvm.

plan-marshall-mcp-integration-tests.description: Container-level integration tests: builds the image via docker compose, starts it with the scripts/ helpers, and runs *IT tests with RestAssured against ports 18080/19000 (MCP endpoint, health, container HEALTHCHECK). Never published.

plan-marshall-mcp-parent.description: Maven aggregator/parent POM for the PM-MCP build: imports the Quarkus, token-sheriff and quarkus-mcp-server BOMs on top of cui-quarkus-parent and wires the coverage profile. Also carries the project-level documentation site.

name: plan-marshall-mcp
